_comment: Custom nodes baked into the packaged ComfyUI at build time by scripts/prepare-comfyui.ps1. Each node is either git-cloned (`repo`) into ComfyUI/custom_nodes/<name>, or copied from the repo (`local`, a path relative to the project root) for nodes we own. `ref` optionally pins a tag/branch/commit for cloned nodes. `pip` lists extra packages to install globally into the bundled Python; requirements.txt inside each node is also installed.

nodes.name: comfyui-nexus-cloud
nodes.note: OUR cloud-GPU node. Provider dropdown (Modal, Beam, Cerebrium, RunPod, Vast) in the sidebar; routes /prompt to the active provider with models on a persistent volume. Modal adapter is the working reference; others are declared stubs.

nodes.name: ComfyUI-Workflow-Models-Downloader
nodes.note: Auto-detects the models a loaded workflow needs and downloads missing ones from HuggingFace/CivitAI/Manager DB into the correct folder (honors extra_model_paths). HTTP API at /workflow-models/* — we trigger a scan on workflow load.
